Relief from the auth platform's per-hour auth-email throttle: no selected evidence describes how that platform-side limit behaves once Loops is the sender, so a higher or unthrottled auth-email ceiling is not established by the selected evidence.

Sending auth email from the exact domain the app is hosted on: E186 recommends a subdomain such as mail.yourcompany.com, so the audience's stated preference for the app's own hosting domain is only partly met and root-domain sending is not established by the selected evidence.
Launch-volume send capacity: no selected evidence states Loops' own sending volume limits or plan allowances, so sufficiency for a public launch announcement is unverified.

Repeated signup testing from one address during pre-launch debugging: no selected evidence documents a test-send, sandbox, or repeat-send allowance for auth email, so this researched trigger behaviour is unverified.
